description: A fixed voltage source with eight voltage channels, each set by its own knob and each able to clone itself across up to 16 polyphonic channels

params.text: Picks that voltage channel as the one the channel count knob applies to
Sets how many channels the picked voltage channel's output carries, 1 to 16; each of the eight keeps its own count and every one starts at 1
Sets the voltage that channel sends out, -10V to +10V, whether or not the channel is picked

outputs.text: Carries the voltage set for that channel, repeated across as many channels as its count sets
Carries all eight set voltages at once, one per polyphonic channel, in channel order from 1 to 8

notes: The module has no inputs: every voltage comes from the knobs, and the display beside each knob reads the voltage it is set to.
